items.title: Adopt the District 3 Pedestrian Safety Improvements Final Report
Approve the Minutes of the June 23, 2020 Meeting –
Allocate $11,230,724 in Prop K Sales Tax Funds and $1,043,898 in Prop AA Vehicle Registration Fee Funds, with Conditions
Adopt the Geneva Avenue/San Jose Avenue Intersection Study Final Report
Approve the Fiscal Year 2020/21 Transportation Fund for Clean Air Program of Projects
Affirm the San Francisco County Transportation Authority’s Commitment to Supporting Efforts to Improve Cost-Effectiveness and to Advance Equity in Project Development
Authorize the Executive Director to Execute Master Agreements, Program Supplemental Agreements, Cooperative Agreements
